apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. Rotator cuff tendinopathy + PT ban on overhead pressing — adding heavy OHP risks turning a healing injury into a chronic one, which delays your bodyweight OHP goal further, not sooner. I won't program that.

What I can do for Wednesday's Upper Body Strength: sub in shoulder-safe pressing variants that keep pressing strength/pattern moving without loading the impinged range — e.g. Landmine Press + Reach (partial ROM, scapular-friendly angle), plus cuff/scap work like Band External Rotation, Face Pulls with External Rotation, Prone YTWs. Want me to build that instead?
